note: The one registry of analysis plugins (docs/design/w3-plugin-manifest.md). UTF-8, LF, no BOM, no tabs, 2-space indent. Consumers: host.py, manifest.py, pc/install_task.ps1, docker/analyzer.Dockerfile, contracts/check_contracts.py. To add a plugin see analysis/README.md, section 'Adding a plugin'.

legacy_order.note: the frozen ORDER of the hand-written text before the manifest (byte-identical --help is a hard requirement); plugins not listed are appended in manifest order. Normalising it is an owner decision (design section 11.2).

extra_rows.label: `novelty`
extra_rows.text: online k-means scene id, distance score, `novel_event` after 3 consecutive outliers; state persists

readme.label: `dsp`
readme.text: per-beam level, band shares, centroid, flatness; one record per transient excursion; tonal-line tracker (appeared/gone, state every 10 s); noise floor + drift

readme.label: `spatial`
readme.text: azimuth + resultant length from the 8-beam energy ring, dominant beam, spread, `directional` vs running baseline, `source` events. Ring frame, uncalibrated

readme.label: `tags`
readme.text: PANNs CNN14 AudioSet top classes (527), speech probability, 2048-d embedding (float16)

readme.label: `clap`
readme.text: LAION-CLAP (htsat-unfused, 48 kHz native) zero-shot scores over `DEFAULT_PROMPTS` (no speech prompts)

flags.name: --tags-pad-s
flags.help: experimental: also run PANNs on the window zero-padded to S s (e.g. 10) -> tags_pad.jsonl; default 0 = off

readme.label: `tags_pad` (opt-in)
readme.text: experimental: PANNs on the window padded to 10 s -> `tags_pad.jsonl` (contract pad-lane); a speech window (padded or unpadded) writes nothing

flags.name: --clap-pad-s
flags.help: experimental: also run CLAP on the window zero-padded to S s (e.g. 10) -> clap_pad.jsonl; default 0 = off

readme.label: `clap_pad` (opt-in)
readme.text: experimental: CLAP on the window padded to 10 s -> `clap_pad.jsonl` (contract pad-lane)

readme.label: `birds`
readme.text: BirdNET on the two strongest beams

flags.name: --coherence-interval-s
flags.help: coherence plugin: seconds per beam_coherence record (default 60)

live.note: optional until the coherence plugin is deployed

readme.label: `coherence`
readme.window: 1 s every 2 s; one record per `--coherence-interval-s` (60)
readme.text: inter-beam MSC (raw, bias floor 0.048), cross-phase, lag, level difference per ring-adjacent pair and octave band, quiet/active; `coherence.jsonl` (contract beam-coherence)

plugins.name: perch

flags.name: --perch-model
flags.help: Perch 2.0 ONNX model file (tools/fetch_perch.py); the perch shadow plugin is off without it

flags.name: --perch-labels
flags.help: Perch label file (default labels.csv next to --perch-model)

flags.name: --perch-embeddings
flags.help: also store the 1536-d float16 Perch embedding of every logged window (perch_emb.f16 + perch_emb.jsonl under --out, 2 x 64 MiB at most); default: no embeddings

flags.name: --perch-device
flags.help: Perch device: cpu (default), auto (the analyzer's device), cuda or cuda:N; never falls back to the CPU silently

flags.name: --perch-ort-dir
flags.help: directory with onnxruntime (e.g. onnxruntime-gpu), appended to sys.path for Perch only

flags.name: --perch-min-logit
flags.help: Perch best-species logit from which it counts as naming a species in the perch_agreement records (default 0.0; logits are uncalibrated: tune it on the data)

live.note: optional: only written when the analyzer runs with --perch-model

plugins.note: deploy is pc only: the image has no onnxruntime and entrypoint.sh passes no --perch-* flags (contracts/specs/perch.md, Deploy)

readme.label: `perch` (opt-in)
readme.text: Perch 2.0 (14,795 labels) SHADOW beside BirdNET: top-5 labels with raw logits (mean of 8 beams, loudest beam), `perch_agreement` per minute; off without `--perch-model`

plugins.name: mixscore

flags.name: --mixscore
flags.help: enable the mixscore plugin (default OFF): BirdNET on the 8-beam mean next to the per-beam birds plugin, metadata in mixscore.jsonl; needs the tags and birds plugins; costs about one more BirdNET per 3 s window

flags.name: --mixscore-every
flags.help: mixscore: score every N-th 3 s window (default 4: the plugin costs about 20 ms CPU per second of audio at 1, which with the other plugins is over the analyzer budget; the cost divides by N; only windows that were scored enter the comparison; N < 4 prints a warning)

live.note: optional: written only when the analyzer runs with --mixscore

plugins.note: frozen legacy wart: the host module docstring never listed mixscore.jsonl (in_docstring false)

readme.label: `mixscore` (opt-in)
readme.text: BirdNET on the power-preserving mean of the 8 aligned beams next to the per-beam `birds` plugin; one `mixscore_compare` record per minute (events both / beam_only / mix_only, best-beam versus mix confidence). Off without `--mixscore`; needs the `tags` and `birds` plugins; metadata only; `mixscore.jsonl` (contract mixscore); `python mixscore_report.py <out>/mixscore.jsonl` prints the comparison

flags.name: --bursts-interval-s
flags.help: bursts plugin: seconds per burst_stats record (default 60)

live.note: optional until the bursts plugin is deployed

readme.label: `bursts`
readme.text: 6-16 kHz impulse detector (1 ms frames, 10 dB over a 3 s median): counts, level, beam spread, gap histogram 5 ms..30 s, modal gap, regularity, modulation 0.3-30 Hz; `bursts.jsonl` (contract burst-stats)

flags.name: --indices-interval-s
flags.help: indices plugin: seconds per acoustic_indices record (default 300)

flags.name: --indices-hop-s
flags.help: indices plugin: seconds between its 5 s windows (default 30)

flags.name: --indices-without-speech-gate
flags.help: start the indices plugin although the tags plugin (the speech gate) is not running; records then say speech_gate false (default: refuse to start without the tagger)

live.note: optional until the indices plugin is deployed

readme.label: `indices`
readme.window: 5 s every 15 s (`--indices-hop-s`); one record per `--indices-interval-s` (300)
readme.text: ACI (1-11 kHz), entropies, Bioacoustic Index (2-8 kHz), NDSI, median level, 4-12 kHz chorus band energy, p10/p50/p90 per interval; `indices.jsonl` (contract acoustic-indices)
